summary.text: Miguel Davila is the Democratic candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A city planner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running to put everyday Nevadans in charge of their future.

paragraphs.text: Miguel Davila earned a high school diploma from Green Valley High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2013, and a graduate degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 2022.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as a city planner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has more than a decade of experience in federal, state and local government in Nevada and is a Venezuelan immigrant.
Davila advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary for District 15.

In the survey, he said his priorities include walkable, affordable neighborhoods, redeveloping vacant lots and buildings, lowering rents, reducing homelessness, and bringing mass transit to the airport.
